name: Kashiwaba Tomoe
source:
Instance of Kashiwaba Tomoe in NOMAD Rozen Maiden continuation, which is also used in TAITO Visual Novels.
She is a class president at Jun Sakurada's class and the last medium of Hinaichigo.
